body.name: Exact one-collision persistence family
body.construction:
For every \(\vartheta\in(-1/100,1/100)\), let
\(\psi^{\diamond}_{\vartheta}\) be obtained from \(\psi^{\diamond}\) by
replacing only \(c_{130}=3/10\) by
\(c_{130}(\vartheta)=3/10+\vartheta\), and let
\(\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}}_{\vartheta}\) be obtained from
\(\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}}\) by the identical replacement of its treated
coordinate.  All other primitive coordinates are unchanged.  Define
\(P^{\diamond}_{\vartheta}=F(\psi^{\diamond}_{\vartheta})\).  Thus
\(\psi^{\diamond}_{0}=\psi^{\diamond}\),
\(\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}}_{0}=\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}}\), and
\(P^{\diamond}_{0}=P^{\diamond}\).  At \(\eta=1/10\) and \(\vartheta=0\), the
machine-readable execution object with identifier
\(\texttt{art:p-diamond-onecollisionatt-v1}\) is the literal reduced-rational
payload in
\(\texttt{discovery/p\_diamond\_onecollisionatt.json}\), with SHA--256 digest
\(\texttt{0b349b718fc0af42aa7a4b992bf1da47008b012c2f957beb7f9306e39ed24326}\).
Its deterministic exact-rational replay checker is
\(\texttt{discovery/replay\_p\_diamond\_onecollisionatt.mjs}\), with SHA--256
digest
\(\texttt{e214fff667396d50282869e59ad3d404b0d5c230f1b7bef31ee34c716309220f}\).
